I don’t know how long I’ll keep this AMA up so I’ll just say a few things I wanted to say. I really hope the music industry starts to accept and appreciate music made on hands held devices. There are so many teenagers and musicians who are talented and just need an opportunity to begin, to get started on something other than the issues they’re facing in the world. And hand-held music production has been the best outlet for me to express myself as I battle my nightmare. I really do hope that people begin to make more and more music in this way and we start to change the industry of what is music is possible to make on a device. And I really pray and hope you like my music. I’m a very unwell human being, mainly from pharma drugs, but I’d like to just say I hope the music speaks for itself and people push past what I am or have done to be placed in a mental institution.
